{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Fine-knit merino turtleneck, slim fit, hip length, deep burgundy (#6D1F2E), merino wool
Straight-leg trousers, high waist, full length to the ankle bone, charcoal (#3A3D42), wool-blend flannel with a thermal lining
Warm tights worn under the trousers, opaque, ankle length, black (#1C1C1C), fleece-lined knit
Long single-breasted wool coat, knee to mid-calf length, dark camel (#8B6B4A), dense wool with a quilted lining
Insulated ankle boots, lace-up with a grippy rubber lug sole, calf-high shaft, black (#1A1A1A), waterproof treated leather with a wool lining
Thick wool socks, mid-calf, heather grey (#8A8D91), merino blend
Chunky scarf, wide and long, wrapped twice, deep forest green (#2F4A3A), soft lambswool
Knitted beanie, snug fit, charcoal (#4A4D52), wool with a fleece band
Lined gloves, wrist length, black (#1C1C1C), leather with a cashmere lining
Structured tote, medium size, shoulder carry, dark brown (#3B2A20), water-resistant grained leather

This outfit works because it keeps the neat business look of a refined knit with tailored trousers while giving real protection for a twenty-minute walk in deep frost and snow. The layers hold warmth at the core, and the long wool coat with the scarf, hat and gloves seals out wind and cold. The waterproof, grippy-soled boots handle snow and road salt, and the leather is easy to wipe clean once you reach the office. The burgundy, charcoal and camel palette stays polished and calm, with the green scarf adding a rich accent."}
